tool_input.command:
python3 -c "
import subprocess,sys,pathlib
v='plugins/harness-creator/vendor/prompt-creator/verify-completeness.py'
ps=sorted(pathlib.Path('plugins/system-spec-harness').rglob('prompts/*.md'))
fail=0
for p in ps:
  r=subprocess.run([sys.executable,v,'--input',str(p)],capture_output=True,text=True)
  if r.returncode!=0: fail+=1; print('FAIL',p,r.returncode,(r.stdout+r.stderr)[:600])
print('total',len(ps),'fail',fail)
"
tool_input.description: Run verify-completeness on all harness prompts
